people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Mahli
people.line: Son of Merari, grandson of Levi.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

people.name: Mushi
people.line: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.

translations.web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
translations.bsb: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites according to their records.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.
